notes: Fixture reference links are kept alongside FIFA's official schedule page.
Additional roster and schedule references are kept from World CDB and RoiBlog for cross-checking country lists and match setup.
Player display names are transliterated to Japanese for UI display while keeping the source name stored internally.
World Football Archive is the primary Japanese player data source for names, clubs, ages, dates of birth, heights, and final-member notes.
FIFA's official squad PDF supplements blank World Football Archive birth date, age, height, and club fields when the player can be matched safely.
FIFA's official squad PDF is also retained as the canonical fallback when World Football Archive cannot be fetched or parsed.
JFA's World Cup squad page is retained as a cross-check source for Japan.
Player current club, position, market value, and international goals are sourced from the public Transfermarkt-derived dataset used as supplemental player metadata.

2025-26 club goals are computed from the same public appearances CSV for matches dated from 2025-07-01 through 2026-06-30 when the player can be safely matched; unmatched players are displayed as '-'.
